annotations.title: Pick Drift of an API model

description: Returns Pick Drift from the published Pickbench benchmark: the share of shopping tasks where an API model, asked the same question three times, did not name the same first brand each time, with its confidence interval and the sampling settings it was measured at (temperature group, reasoning effort, output cap). Values are comparable only between models with the same settings. One model, or every model. Read-only.

locale.description: Language of the human-readable text: en, ru or es (default en). Codes, names and ids stay untranslated.

model.description: An API model id or name, e.g. openai/gpt-6-luna.

name: pick_drift

claims.description: Headline claims of the claims engine: a stable code, its parameters and the only number renderings it allows.
